$comment: Iron Ring roster (docs/design/setting.md). Playable fighters are defined in Fighters/<Name>/<id>.fighter.json; the rest are planned.

fighters.name: Dee Marlowe
fighters.identity: Banned Golden Gloves contender. Compact pressure, a precise jab, punishes whiffs.

fighters.name: Bram Hollis
fighters.identity: Laid-off shipyard rigger and the Ring's reigning gatekeeper. Slow advance, close-range reads, a command throw.

fighters.name: Sable Reyes
fighters.identity: Night courier who fights for the purse. Air movement, angle changes and fast kicks.

fighters.name: Idris Okafor
fighters.identity: Former merchant sailor stranded in Grayhaven. Controls space with long kicks and deliberate recovery.

fighters.name: Greta Voll
fighters.identity: Foundry forewoman settling a score with the Broker. Stable guard and heavy short-range punishes.

fighters.name: Jun Arata
fighters.identity: Pickpocket who works the crowd between bouts. Low movement and quick pressure resets.
